name: Runbook
description: Operational procedure assembled from the spec's runbook steps and dependencies.
prompt_template:
You are writing a runbook for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: when_to_use, preconditions, steps, verification, rollback.
